newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Shell cuts most petroleum product prices.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Shell cuts most petroleum product prices.

text.p: Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp will reduce prices of most petroleum products on Saturday, when full deregulation of the oil industry is due to start, documents released by the company showed.

Pilipinas Shell said on Friday prices of regular gasoline will be reduced by 2.61 centavos, jet fuel by 16.40 centavos, kerosene by 7.27 centavos, diesel by 11.70 centavos and fuel oil by 9.41 centavos.
But the pump price of premium gasoline will be raised by 41.73 centavos per litre, unleaded gasoline will be raised by 0.81 centavos and liquefied petroleum gasoline by 62.49 centavos per litre.
Pilipinas Shell is a member of the Royal Dutch/Shell group of companies.
On Thursday, Shell's rival Petron Corp had announced an adjustment in its prices.
